faqs.question: Do you respond in our brand voice?
faqs.answer: Yes — we manage replies in your tone, with clear guidelines for escalation so sensitive messages reach your team.

faqs.question: Can you handle Arabic and English audiences?
faqs.answer: Yes — bilingual community management so both audiences get prompt, natural responses.

faqs.question: Do you deliver in Arabic and English?
faqs.answer: Yes — bilingual Arabic + English with full RTL support, so both audiences get a first-class experience.

faqs.question: Do we own the result?
faqs.answer: Completely. You keep the accounts, data, and configurations. There is no lock-in to CloudTopia.
